summary: Fix stale SSH terminal resume by reconciling session-route navigation against ready SessionService state before terminal UI is allowed to render. Implement a pure stale-session decision helper plus Compose integration that immediately gates stale terminal content, then performs state cleanup/navigation from a keyed LaunchedEffect. Preserve valid live-session resume from notification, launcher, Activity Manager, and recreation paths, and add deterministic regression coverage plus targeted instrumentation where available.
assumptions: The previous screen should come from the existing routeBeforeConnecting only if it is a valid non-session destination; if it is CONNECTING, SESSION, blank, or otherwise invalid, fall back to Routes.HOME.
Stale-session cleanup must not run until the SessionService/runtime is ready, because an initially empty snapshot list before binding is not proof that a session is gone.

A valid live SSH terminal route requires a matching non-terminal-error SessionSnapshot and, for rendered terminal UI, a resolvable TerminalEmulator or an explicitly pending new connection request that has not yet produced its first snapshot.

Existing error/failure UI should be preserved if it is intentionally represented by a snapshot that the current ConnectingScreen can render; only routes with no backing live/pending/renderable session should be treated as stale.
Cold launch from a stale ACTION_OPEN_SESSION notification has no meaningful previous route and should land on Home without ever drawing an empty terminal pane.
Foreground stale ACTION_OPEN_SESSION while already on a valid non-session route should consume the stale request without unnecessarily navigating away from that route.

tasks.title: Trace terminal route lifecycle
tasks.description: Inspect MainActivity, SSHPeachesRoot, ConnectingScreen, SessionService, and existing live/open-session tests to confirm how requestedOpenSessionId, quickConnectRequest, routeBeforeConnecting, sessionSnapshots, pending connection state, and resolveTerminalEmulator interact. Identify foreground entry paths: onStart/onResume, onNewIntent notification open, launcher relaunch, Activity Manager restore, and configuration recreation.
verification: Document the stale path: current route remains CONNECTING/SESSION while the service is ready, snapshots contain no backing session, and terminal content can be requested with no emulator/session.

Confirm existing valid-session tests that must continue passing: backgroundAndForegroundWhileTerminalSessionIsOpen_keepsConnectingRoute, recreateWhileTerminalSessionIsOpen_restoresConnectingRoute, openSessionIntentColdLaunch_restoresExistingLiveTerminal, launcherRelaunchShowsOpenSessionAndResumesItFromHome.

tasks.title: Expose session runtime readiness
tasks.description: Extend SSHPeachesRootRuntime with a boolean such as sessionRuntimeReady/sessionServiceReady. Pass sessionService != null from MainActivity after binding. Use this readiness flag in all stale-route/open-session decisions so an empty snapshot list before service binding never causes a false redirect.
verification: All SSHPeachesRootRuntime call sites compile after adding the readiness flag.
Code inspection confirms stale cleanup cannot run solely because initial snapshots are empty while service is not ready.

tasks.title: Add pure stale-session decision helper
tasks.description: Create a small pure helper that decides whether the current session route or requested open-session id is stale. Inputs should include runtime readiness, current route, requestedOpenSessionId, quickConnectRequest.sessionId, pending new-connection state, session snapshots, terminal-emulator availability when needed, and routeBeforeConnecting. Outputs should include whether to gate terminal content, whether to consume requestedOpenSessionId, and the validated recovery route. Validate routeBeforeConnecting so session routes or invalid routes fall back to Routes.HOME.
verification: Unit tests cover service not ready with empty snapshots does not redirect.
Unit tests cover service ready with missing requested session redirects or consumes stale request.
Unit tests cover service ready with matching live snapshot preserves terminal route.
Unit tests cover stale routeBeforeConnecting values fall back to Routes.HOME.
Unit tests cover foreground stale open-session request on an existing non-session route consumes the request without forcing unnecessary navigation.

tasks.title: Gate stale terminal rendering before draw
tasks.description: Integrate the helper into SSHPeachesRoot so stale CONNECTING/SESSION content is synchronously suppressed during composition before ConnectingScreen or SessionVerticalContent can draw an empty terminal frame. Do not mutate Compose state or navigate directly from the render branch. Render the validated recovery screen or neutral non-terminal content for that composition pass so there is no fade, animation, brief flicker, or empty terminal pane.
verification: Stale route never invokes ConnectingScreen with request=null or with a request whose sessionId has no backing live/pending/renderable session after runtime readiness.
Valid live-session routes still render ConnectingScreen/terminal content when a matching snapshot exists.
A brand-new pending connection is exempt only while a concrete pending request exists and has not had a chance to create its first snapshot.

tasks.title: Perform cleanup and navigation as side effects
tasks.description: Add a LaunchedEffect or equivalent controlled side-effect keyed on the stale decision. From that effect, clear requestedOpenSessionId through onOpenSessionRequestHandled, clear quickConnectRequest/quickConnectState/pendingConnectingNavigation through existing handlers as appropriate, and navigate to the helper's validated recovery route using no-animation route replacement semantics. Avoid redirect loops by using launchSingleTop/popUpTo only with validated non-session destinations.
verification: No state mutation or navController navigation occurs directly during composition.
Stale ACTION_OPEN_SESSION is consumed once runtime is ready and does not remain pending forever.
Cold stale notification launch lands on Home.
Foreground stale notification from a non-session route consumes the request and keeps the current valid route when appropriate.
Back-button behavior remains unchanged for live sessions.

tasks.title: Add root navigation regression tests
tasks.description: Add deterministic tests for the pure helper and, where the existing architecture allows, Compose/root navigation behavior without requiring a live SSH backend. Cover stale route gating, readiness delay, valid live snapshot preservation, requestedOpenSessionId handling, and routeBeforeConnecting validation.
verification: Core stale-route behavior is covered by tests that can run without emulator/live SSH infrastructure.
Tests assert terminal content is gated for stale routes before cleanup navigation completes.
Tests assert no redirect while service is not ready.

tasks.title: Add foreground-resume instrumentation coverage
tasks.description: Add or update instrumentation tests in the existing live/session area. Cover opening an SSH terminal from Hosts, backgrounding the app, stopping or allowing SessionService to lose the backing session while backgrounded, resuming through a foreground path, and asserting the app returns to Hosts/Home with SCREEN_CONNECTING and CONNECTING_TERMINAL_PANEL absent. Keep the existing live-session background/resume test to prove active sessions are preserved when background sessions remain allowed.
verification: New stale foreground-resume test fails before the production fix and passes after it.
Test asserts both route recovery and absence of the terminal panel after resume.
Existing valid live-session resume/recreate tests continue to pass.

tasks.title: Add stale open-session intent instrumentation coverage
tasks.description: Add a test near OpenSessionIntentLaunchTest that creates a real session, captures its session id, closes/stops it, then launches MainActivity with SessionService.ACTION_OPEN_SESSION for that stale id. Assert the app shows Home or preserves the prior valid non-session route and never displays the terminal panel. Keep the existing valid openSessionIntentColdLaunch_restoresExistingLiveTerminal test unchanged.
verification: Stale notification/open intent is consumed and does not show ConnectingScreen.
Valid notification/open intent still restores the live terminal.
Foreground stale notification does not disturb an already-visible valid non-session route unless recovery from a stale session route is required.

tasks.title: Run targeted verification
tasks.description: Run focused compile and test commands without denied operations. Prefer ./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin, the deterministic unit tests added for the helper/root behavior, and connected Android tests for LiveTransportTest and OpenSessionIntentLaunchTest. If no emulator/live SSH backend is available, run compile/unit checks and report the blocked connected-test requirement with the exact failure.
verification: ./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin
Run the relevant unit test task containing the stale-session decision tests.

./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=com.majordaftapps.sshpeaches.app.live.LiveTransportTest,com.majordaftapps.sshpeaches.app.live.OpenSessionIntentLaunchTest
If connectedDebugAndroidTest cannot run because emulator or live backend is unavailable, include the exact failure and confirm compile/unit verification passed.

risks: Redirecting before SessionService binding completes would break valid notification/launcher resume; the readiness flag must gate stale decisions.
A LaunchedEffect-only redirect can still allow one frame of empty terminal UI; immediate content gating must provide the no-flicker guarantee.
State mutation or navigation during composition can cause Compose side-effect bugs; cleanup must happen in a controlled side effect keyed on a stable stale decision.
routeBeforeConnecting can create loops if it points back to CONNECTING or SESSION; it must be validated before navigation.
Treating all error snapshots as nonexistent could remove intentional failed-connection UI; the predicate must distinguish renderable failure state from missing backing session.
Live instrumentation tests may require an emulator, notification permission, and the repository's live SSH backend configuration, so deterministic helper/root tests are needed as fallback coverage.
The existing git worktree may contain unrelated changes, so edits must stay tightly scoped and must not revert user work.
